red_tests.failure_fingerprint: Legacy expectation conflicted with the Package 10 persistence truth contract by accepting QUEUED_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW after HITL storage failure.

correction_reason: Package 10 established that QUEUED_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW may be reported only after successful HITL persistence. This supersedes the older Package 03 compatibility expectation for the enqueue-failure case while preserving the no-exception response contract.
rationale: The corrected test keeps the original safety property that a reading response must still return when HITL storage fails, and adds the stricter truthfulness requirement that the public routing status must not claim a successful queue write.
